proposals.evidence: DEDR 3419 full article (p. 299) gives 3419 Ta. teri (-v-, -nt-) to be seen, perceived, ascertained, become evident, be understood, intelligible, clear, possess the power of sight, be conscious (as of one's guilt); investigate, t Bhat teri “to know” matches Lindgren Koraga teri “know (something)” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
